units.source_text: 柏木平日那种叙述反论时的哲学式的爽快性，早已从他的脸上消失了。

en.t: The philosophical briskness that Kashiwagi usually showed when setting out an argument had long since vanished from his face.

units.source_text: 他咪缠着眼睛，用迷惘的眼神望着我说：

en.t: He narrowed his eyes and looked at me with a bewildered gaze, then said:
